summary: Tested Cockpit Prospection backend (10 pytest cases) + frontend (navigation, queue actions, settings persistence, AI improve). 9/10 backend pass. Frontend flows largely working: file-du-jour stats, queue with rendered messages, mark-sent removes prospect, settings persist into rendered messages, navigation across all 6 pages, prospect sheet with sequence preview/actions. ONE CRITICAL BUG: /api/ai/improve returns 502 because model name 'gpt-5.4' is invalid for Emergent LLM key.

critical.issue: Returns 502 'Invalid model name passed in model=gpt-5.4'. The model 'gpt-5.4' does not exist on Emergent LLM key. server.py line 572 uses .with_model('openai', 'gpt-5.4'). Must use a valid model name such as 'gpt-5', 'gpt-4o', or similar. The Paramètres UI also displays 'GPT-5.4' in informational text.

integration_issues.issue: Clicking btn-ai-improve-message triggers backend 502 (invalid gpt-5.4 model). Textarea content unchanged. No visible error toast surfaced to user — only a 502 logged in browser console.

design_issues.screen: Prospect detail Sheet (and possibly other Dialog usages)
issues: Accessibility console warnings: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle' and 'Missing Description or aria-describedby'. Should wrap title with VisuallyHidden or add aria-describedby.

action_items: FIX server.py line 572: replace .with_model('openai', 'gpt-5.4') with a valid Emergent-supported model (e.g. 'gpt-5' or current GPT chat model). Update Parametres.jsx informational text if it references 'GPT-5.4'.
Surface AI errors via a toast in ProspectSheet so users see why the message did not change (currently silent failure).
Add DialogTitle/Description (or VisuallyHidden wrapper) to Sheet / Dialog components to remove a11y warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 634 lines — borderline; consider splitting routes (prospects, scrape, scenarios, ai, settings) into separate routers.
Hard-coded model 'gpt-5.4' is brittle — load from env (e.g., AI_MODEL) with a sensible default.
/api/ai/improve has no rate limiting and no input length cap on body.message — risk of token abuse.
Import endpoint does no max file size check beyond FastAPI default — could be DoS vector.
build_queue_item recomputes scenario for every queue item (1 mongo query each). For large queues this is N+1. Cache scenarios in-memory or fetch once.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (only AI improve flow broken due to backend model name)

seed_data_creation: Backend tests create TEST_-prefixed CSV import prospects and clean them up. Scrape test ran 1 gouv electricien/Dijon job (5 limit) which may have added real prospects to DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tested everything in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — re-run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v. After main agent fixes the AI model name, only need to re-test TestAI::test_ai_improve and the frontend btn-ai-improve-message flow. Other flows (dashboard stats, queue, mark-sent, settings persistence in messages, scenarios save, CSV import + dedupe, prospect actions envoye/repondu/reactiver, gouv scrape job completion) are confirmed working end-to-end.
rca of the issue: POST /api/ai/improve invokes LlmChat(...).with_model('openai', 'gpt-5.4') in server.py:572. The litellm router rejects 'gpt-5.4' as a non-existent OpenAI model ('Invalid model name passed in model=gpt-5.4'). Mitigation: change to a valid model identifier (e.g. 'gpt-5' or 'gpt-4o-mini') and ideally read from env var AI_MODEL with a default.
